crossRefs.note: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.
I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not…
Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.
All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.”
God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who…
Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.
Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples. Proclaim that…
Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all the peoples, nations, and languages, who dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to…
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

translations.web: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
translations.bsb: the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.
translations.kjv: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
translations.asv: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor, And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.
